title: Buttercream Frosting
description: Silky buttercream on a cooked egg and sugar base. Enough for one two-layer cake.

steps.text: Whisk the eggs, sugar, vanilla, and salt in a heatproof bowl.
Put the bowl over a pan of simmering water. Whisk all the time until the mixture is at 160°F (71°C).
Take the bowl off the heat. Beat on medium-high speed for 5 minutes, until the mixture is thick and cool.
Cut the butter into 16 to 20 pieces.

steps.action: beat butter in on low speed
steps.text: On low speed, beat in the butter one piece at a time.
Beat until the frosting is smooth and silky. If it looks split, keep beating. It comes together.
